title: Journalist who exposed alleged drug links shot dead in Costa Rica
html:
Journalist who exposed alleged drug links shot dead in Costa Rica

Costa Rican journalist Camilo Rodriguez has been shot dead near the capital San Jose. Known for publishing allegations about links between politicians and drug traffickers, his killing is the country’s first known murder of a journalist in over two decades.
summary: Costa Rican journalist Camilo Rodriguez has been shot dead near the capital San Jose.
